_note: BUILDING-FACE-POSE-1. Third map in the building-wall grading matrix. Sites are building-class object clusters read out of the mission .pak packet-1 object list and classified by ObjectTypeClass (method note in mc2_10_building_faces.json). 'palace' = the 20-object cluster at (28,5103): s_main, s_main_leftwing, s_main_rightwing, s_gov2, s_govresidence, s_adminquarter -- the tallest authored buildings on any tier map, and mc2_24's high sun (LightDirPitch 75 deg) throws hard ground shadows that make the light direction unambiguous in-frame. 'fortress' = the walled turret city around (-763,2652); note this map's wall segments chain across the whole fortress, so that cluster is one continuous compound rather than a discrete building group. Sun azimuth = LightDirYaw(300)+45 = 345 deg. Two rotations 180 deg apart at the palace put the light-facing wall in one frame and the light-away wall in the other. The control frames the rock outcrop area at (3200,3413), which carries terrain-object props but no building-class object -- deliberately not empty ground, so it also shows whether a prop-lighting change leaks onto non-building props.
